dimensions.assessment: Effects depend entirely on the amount of forfeited funds collected from specific individuals or entities associated with the Chavez or Maduro regimes.

dimensions.evidence: There is established in the Treasury of the United States a fund, to be known as the 'Venezuela Restoration Fund'

dimensions.evidence: There is established in the Treasury of the United States a fund, to be known as the 'Venezuela Restoration Fund'

dimensions.assessment: Funds are available without fiscal year limitation, and reporting requirements continue annually on an ongoing basis.
